title: Glokzin Teal Makeup Mirror, 8-Inch Double-Sided 2X, Freestanding Solid Brass, Adjustable Height, Allied Brass
description: Make-up mirror with 8-inch diameter double-faced mirror glass, freestanding solid brass construction, and adjustable height for bathroom vanity makeup and shaving — available in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Dual-sided design provides 2X magnification on one side and a regular 1X mirror on the opposite side for close-up grooming and an all-around check. Traditional style with classic accents; heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping and a felt pad helps prevent scratching on countertops and vanities. Some assembly required. Assembled in the U.S.A. Product size: 10.5 in L x 56-68 in H x 10.5 in W. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
